comparison.objective: Seat and quarter-turn a Sankey coupler on a keg, then lower its handle to drive the probe.
comparison.physical_skill: Tight axial alignment, bayonet engagement, rotation under lugs, and ordered over-center handle actuation.
comparison.success_condition: Coupler caught and turned about 85–90 degrees before handle engagement, probe substantially inserted, keg/lines undamaged, hands clear and mechanism still.
comparison.reason: This is the closest shared align-rotate-lock sequence, but it tests bayonet coupling and ordered probe actuation. The candidate additionally requires fine setscrew tooling, moving-socket reacquisition, and tuning from repeated impact measurements.
